summary: Parked-up residential kerb on Beatrice Street, with apartments and homes close on both sides.

best_section.where: West kerb on Beatrice Street, between the corner and the next block of flats

drivers.seclusion: Dense units and houses on both sides; nearest dwellings 11-16 m on the same side, so overlooked.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with parked cars along the kerb; room to stop in the parking lane.
drivers.traffic: Quiet side street near a junction; some through traffic.
drivers.convention: Cars park here, but signs show 2P Mon-Fri 9am-4pm and a No Stopping zone near the start.

flags: No Stopping Any Time sign near the start
sun_shade: Mostly open; trees on the east side give afternoon shade, buildings on the west side shade mornings.
cannot_judge: Exact sign coverage along the section
